category: inference gateway, free model plus paid per-token

free_tier.stated: one serverless chat model is listed at USD 0 input and USD 0 output per million tokens, Prism-ML/Ternary-Bonsai-27B (262,144 context); all other models are paid per token and no separate free-token quota is published

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible key at api.together.xyz and the Together CLI/SDKs
chaining: pairs with an OpenAI-compatible agent through the one free model; the scarce link is that a single small model is free and service is best-effort

limits.value: Ternary Bonsai 27B is Free input and Free output per 1M tokens; serverless performance is best-effort

binding_note: the free model has no published rate ceiling, so nothing binds above the working scale for it

identity_cost.detail: an API key from the Together AI console is required; signup fields not stated on the docs pages read

reliability_note: serverless performance is best-effort; 429 and 503 responses can occur at high demand and a model in high demand may get custom access restrictions

evidence.proved: a free chat model at USD 0 input and output per million tokens
evidence.quote: | Prism ML | Ternary Bonsai 27B | Prism-ML/Ternary-Bonsai-27B | 262144 | Free | - | Free | - | Yes | Yes |

notes: a genuine $0 model is in the first-party catalog; only one model is free and no free allowance quota for it is published.
